Senior Software Engineer role focused on building and maintaining event-driven microservices and integrations around an Akeneo PIM platform serving global retail commerce. The work covers product catalog modeling, delta-calculation engines, connectors and APIs, plus keeping the live SaaS/Enterprise PIM running and upgraded. Core stack is Java/Spring Boot with Node.js, TypeScript, Go or Python, Apache Kafka (alongside RabbitMQ and IBM MQ) for streaming, relational and NoSQL stores including Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB and Redis, and Kubernetes/Docker on GCP, AWS or Azure.
